title: How Uber & DoorDash empower developers to preview every code change in production
summary: The blog post discusses the challenges faced by Uber and DoorDash in their quest for efficient testing in production. Uber, dealing with unreliable end-to-end tests and conflicts over staging environments, developed SLATE (Short-Lived Application Testing Environment) to create on-demand ephemeral testing environments. This improved isolation and developer velocity. On the other hand, DoorDash, striving for faster feedback, adopted a new approach to preview features in the production Kubernetes environment, enhancing their product development process.
